create_nav_goal_sensor: create a NavGoalPointGoalSensor to provide GPS and compass observations relative to the navigation goal position
create_oracle_nav_sensor: create an OracleNavigationActionSensor to compute shortest path navigation actions to a target point
build_nav_reward: build a NavToObjReward measure that computes distance and angle-based rewards for navigation to object tasks
create_dist_to_goal: create a DistToGoal measure to compute the Euclidean distance between the agent and the navigation goal
create_nav_success_measure: create a NavToObjSuccess measure to evaluate whether the agent has successfully navigated to the target object
